algorithms.summary: Genetic PDE and tabular search with SGA's internal sparse fit.

modes.name: autograd
modes.description: SGA trains its own field surrogate and differentiates it with autograd; the facade selects it with derivatives="autograd".

modes.name: tabular
modes.description: Algebraic structure search over fixed regression columns.

fields.name: p_var
fields.description: Probability that a node in a freshly generated term tree is a variable rather than an operator.

algorithms.summary: Neural-surrogate genetic search for constant-coefficient PDEs.

modes.name: default
modes.description: The raw field and every derivative order are read from a trained neural surrogate. Calibrated surrogate budget: 5000 epochs (surrogate_max_epochs), the smallest measured budget at which the true law of a one-field u_t test case fits the surrogate's own columns within 5% on every coefficient (noise 0 and 0.05, three seeds); the config default stays 50000.

algorithms.summary: Risk-seeking reinforcement-learning search over PDE terms (grid) or tabular expressions

modes.name: mode1
modes.description: Grid search whose default vocabulary is every field of the dataset (the target is its left-hand side), the grid's spatial axes (x, and y on a 2-D grid), t, and diff and diff2 along each spatial axis.

modes.name: mode2
modes.description: PINN surrogate mode that pretrains one network on every field of the observations, searches mode1's vocabulary on its autograd derivatives, and retrains the network on the best equation at every cycle boundary.

fields.name: epsilon
fields.description: Risk-seeking reward quantile: the top-epsilon fraction of a batch's rewards feeds the policy-gradient update.

fields.name: magnitude_filter
fields.description: Reject fitted coefficients outside the reference magnitude bounds.

fields.name: pinn
fields.description: Settings for the optional PINN surrogate, which alternates symbolic search with training a network on the data and takes derivatives from that trained network.

algorithms.summary: One-shot PySR search over a configured kd term library (PDE mode) or dataset-derived feature columns (tabular mode).

modes.name: default
modes.description: Grid evolution search over explicit kd terms.

modes.name: tabular
modes.description: Scalar symbolic regression on tabular X -> y data.

algorithms.summary: GPT-guided discovery of grid u_t evolution PDEs in one field u, and of scattered 2-D steady relations; no u_tt

modes.name: single_wave
modes.description: Grid evolution in field u with spatial axes from x/y/z and time t.

modes.name: wave_multicase
modes.description: Reproduction of the bundled wave-breaking cases only; not selectable from benchmark data.

modes.name: steady
modes.description: Scattered (x, y), field u, homogeneous; retrains a surrogate inside every call.

fields.name: top_k
fields.description: Elite-pool and fine-tune slice size; on a resume a smaller value truncates the restored pool, while a larger one does not widen it (the merge never grows a non-empty pool).

fields.name: case_filter
fields.description: Wave_multicase only: substring matched against the wave-breaking case names: every case whose name contains it is scored, and a candidate's reward is the mean over the cases that could be scored.

fields.name: steady_activation
fields.description: Activation function of the surrogate network trained in steady mode, either ``"sin"`` or ``"rational"``.

algorithms.summary: Budgeted LLM proposal and sparse-reward PDE and tabular search.

modes.name: default
modes.description: LLM proposals over field u and spatial axes x and y.

modes.name: tabular
modes.description: LLM formula proposals over the feature columns of a table.

fields.name: fit_stop_threshold
fields.description: Optional completion threshold for the best sparse-reward candidate's unrounded 1/(1+NRMSE). None disables fit stopping.

algorithms.summary: One-shot native PySINDy STLSQ over a configured kd term library (grid mode) or a feature-derived polynomial library (tabular mode).

modes.name: default
modes.description: Grid evolution regression over explicit kd terms.

modes.name: tabular
modes.description: Polynomial regression on tabular X -> y data.

fields.name: relative_threshold
fields.description: Read threshold as a fraction of the target L2 norm (requires normalize_columns).

fields.name: degree
fields.description: Maximum total polynomial degree for tabular data.
